entry.title: dotnet/maui - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-11-11
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • [Agent] Create MAUI expert #32507
    .NET 11 Planning
  • [NET 10, iOS 26] Liquid glass hamburger and toolbar icon flashing #32506
  • Tracking: Replace deprecated Azure DevOps screen resolution utility for UITests #32505
  • Random Build Failure - Provision Android SDK (MSB3073) #32504
  • Intermittent build error - CS0016: Could not write to output file (path not found) #32503
  • [NET 10, Android] `SafeAreaEdges="None"` works on API 36 but not on older APIs like 31 #32498
    .NET 10.0 SR2
  • The flyout icon is getting tinted on Android and loses colours (becomes monochromatic) #32495
  • Selected item color changes from lightskyblue to lightgray after scrolling when deploying ManualMaui Demo project on iOS 26.1 #32493
  • [Essentials] TTS rate #32492

Closed

  • [Agent] Create copilot instructions that outline updates from .NET 9 to .NET 10 #32185
    .NET 10.0 GA
  • [dnceng-bot] Branch `maui/inflight/current` can't be mirrored to Azdo fast forward branch #32500
  • error CS8603: Possible null reference return in generated code using SourceGen #32478
    .NET 10.0 SR2
  • [.NET 10] The gap in the bottom of the emulator increases while scrolling. #32436
